subject: A pure DATA decoder must not gain a live-session authorization gate while adding a bounded per-scope cache.
portable_findings: Freeze the old public contract before candidate review. The pure decoder originally works on valid byte input without a live writer Session, including legitimately escaped borrowed facades. A newly throwing session gate would break that behavior.

The allowed new optimization uses only existing private thread-local scope context and object identity to choose cache versus original strict fallback. These memory checks are not current eligibility or authority. All physical readers keep their original fresh permission, metadata, identity, original-byte and Session checks.

Cache only privately decoded immutable Gameplay DATA. Retain private input snapshots and full byte equality, finite entry/key-byte bounds, strict malformed/overlimit fallback, and no nonGameplay admission. Read-only wrapping alone would not make an exposed backing array safe.

A successful DATA memo hit must coexist with rejection of a stale facade physical read. Real temporary Writer-issued Sessions can test this separation without constructing a private issuer or touching a Game.

Historical-read guards and cleanup remain on the old branch. Nested/exceptional cleanup, another thread fallback, and a completed failed historical scope must not leave ordinary pure decode bound to a dead guard.
